_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 35 windows moving ±2+ points in 7 days, this is a confirmed coil where HOLD is the skilled call—directional fuel exists (extreme fed_liquidity, one-sided short positioning) but no catalyst has landed to break the compression.
next_move.brains_agree: Both agree on eventual upside direction, but split on timing conviction: narrative treats accumulation as imminent mean-reversion fuel; analyst names the long explicitly as a low-conviction bet against the coil, requiring a catalyst to fire.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding rises above 0.015% with spot CVD breaking above 80 and fed_liquidity ticking up from 0; or a sharp DXY drop below 99.0 with gold holding 95+
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC funding turns negative with exchange netflow rising above 70; or VIX breaking above 20 with DXY above 100—risk-off traps longs and validates coil as pre-breakdown
